interventions.step: Install the brand theme and the screen's components
interventions.action: Ran the Export theme command as `npx shadcn@4.21.4 add "<theme url>"` instead of `npx shadcn@latest add`, and added components with `npx shadcn@4.21.4 add @ultima/select @ultima/field @ultima/input @ultima/badge @ultima/toggle-group @ultima/empty --yes` instead of the documented unversioned `npx shadcn add`.
interventions.reason: To use the same shadcn version the init plan pinned for its own installs (shadcn@4.21.4), so all registry installs in the project ran through one known version. The guidance names `@latest` / unversioned.

interventions.step: Replace the init preview with the Pantry screen
interventions.action: Deleted src/app/setup-check.tsx, the client part of init's starter preview, after replacing src/app/page.tsx with the Pantry route.
interventions.reason: The starter page says it can be edited or replaced, but nothing says to remove its helper file; once nothing imports it, it's dead code.

interventions.step: Verify the production build in a browser
interventions.action: Installed playwright-core in ./.scratch/browser and drove the system Chromium against `npm run start`. Set TMPDIR=/tmp/ldr for those runs and deleted that directory afterward.
interventions.reason: The guidance asks for production checks of the root, a control and a portalled popup in both modes but provides no tool for them. Chromium aborted with 'Socket path too long' under the deep default temp path, so a short temp directory was needed.

decisions.choice: Accept the documented fallback font stack instead of loading Figtree
options: Load Figtree in the app (for example next/font/google or self-hosted files)
Accept the fallback stack the theme exports (ui-sans-serif, system-ui, ...)
decisions.why: The theme names Figtree but loads no faces, and the guidance allows either option. Loading it would fetch from a host other than the run's public Ultima host at build time, so the screen renders in the system UI fallback.

decisions.choice: Put the layout breakpoint in the app's token module as `stylex.defineConsts` (src/components/pantry/screen.stylex.ts) instead of as a named constant in pantry.tsx
options: Named module constant in the file that uses it (Ultima's stated rule, as in the Projects lesson)
defineConsts in the application's own .stylex.ts token module, beside defineVars sizes
decisions.why: The brief says the app sets no lengths outside its theme and token modules. defineConsts can be used as a media-query key and still passes StyleX lint and the build, so every app length (content max width, breakpoint) lives in one token module.

decisions.choice: Use a vertical, single-select ToggleGroup for the stock list, with style-prop overrides for row layout
options: Item recipe rows inside a Card with a trailing Button per row
Table with a per-row action (needs a sideways-scrolling region at phone width)
Vertical ToggleGroup whose pressed item is the selection
decisions.why: The guidance does not cover a selectable master list. ToggleGroup gives pressed state, roving arrow-key focus and accent-bordered selection from component state with no extra ARIA. A Table would scroll sideways inside its region, which the brief rules out. Row layout uses only space/text tokens through the `style` slot.

decisions.choice: Pick the category with an inline portalled Select instead of opening the donation form in a Dialog
options: Portalled Select inside an always-visible form card
Form inside a Dialog opened from a button
decisions.why: The brief allows either. At the intake desk, an always-visible form saves a step for each donation. Select portals to document.body, where the root CSS theme still reaches it, so no portal container is needed.

interventions.reason: init's plan pins shadcn@4.21.4 for its own installs while Studio and the guides print @latest or no version, so the agent chose a version the guidance does not name.

interventions.action: Installed playwright-core in ./.scratch/browser and drove the system Chromium against `npm run start` with TMPDIR=/tmp/ldr, deleting it afterwards.
interventions.reason: Chromium aborted with 'Socket path too long' under the harness's per-run TMPDIR. That is a harness defect, but the workaround is an unprinted action.

decisions.choice: Put the layout breakpoint in the app token module as `stylex.defineConsts` (src/components/pantry/screen.stylex.ts) rather than as a named constant in pantry.tsx.
options: Named module constant in the file that uses it, as the Projects lesson does
defineConsts in the application's .stylex.ts token module
decisions.why: The brief says the application decides no lengths outside its theme and token modules, while the Projects lesson declares its media queries as constants in the screen file. Neither settles which rule wins for a breakpoint.

review.notes: No documentation rendering, data-link decoding or JavaScript-bundle extraction, and no reference to the live host or another checkout. The agent read llms.txt, four guides, the projects and product-tokens lessons and the Item recipe over HTTP, and probed one guessed /components/toggle-group.md URL. It did not read CRM 01's source; it composed the list from a vertical ToggleGroup and says the guidance does not cover a selectable list. That composition is a choice among documented components and is not counted, but it is the same gap the Vite and Next root runs met. init's src layout imports ultima-theme.css from src/app/layout.tsx as printed, and no Geist loading appears (#811 holds). Deleting init's setup-check preview follows the starter comment and is not counted. Lint, doctor, check (also --strict), the raw-paint scan and every external production assertion passed. The font fallback and Select over Dialog are documented or product choices and are not counted. No operator edited the application.
